4a7d9a.title: Agent execution boundary audit — validation summary
4a7d9a.content:
Audited tool execution/approval boundary (Agent 92a0a860). Confirmed via local harness importing real repo code (tsx + repo .env):

1. **vuln-0006 (critical)** — backend `claude-agent.service.ts:410-411` hardcodes `permissionMode:'bypassPermissions'` + `allowDangerouslySkipPermissions:true`; sole guard is `dangerousCommandBlocker` regex denylist in `claude-hooks.ts`. Proven bypassable: `python3 -c "open('/tmp/PWNED_VIA_HOOK_BYPASS','w')"` passes the hook and marker file created on host. Also: Write file_path guard uses un-normalized `startsWith(cwd)` (cwd/../../etc/shadow passes); backend env (AWS keys, AUTH_TOKEN) passed to agent subprocess.

2. **vuln-0007 (critical)** — agentcore container `agent-runner.ts:286-287` same hardcoded bypass; **zero PreToolUse hooks** in entire agentcore/src (only PostToolUse S3-sync + Stop full-sync). Untrusted inputs: S3-restored workspace skills/CLAUDE.md, RAG via injected AUTH_TOKEN, WebFetch. Stop-hook syncs attacker files back to org S3 (persistence).

Coverage: agentcore-command.service sanitizePath/shellEscape clean (no_issue_found); RAG→prompt injection reachability left needs_follow_up (requires live model; the *consequence* boundary is separately confirmed broken by the two reports). Scratch harness in /tmp/harness (t1_hooks.mts, t2_exec.mts, t3_options.mts).
